result.title: How Sullivan & Cromwell builds legal tools with Codex | OpenAI
result.description:
At Sullivan & Cromwell LLP, John Savva uses Codex to build tools around the firm’s legal expertise.

Agreement Analyzer brings together a draft agreement, selected precedents, and playbooks reflecting the firm’s and client’s positions. It identifies potential issues and returns a memo and proposed tracked changes for a lawyer to review.

Lawyers can inspect the sources and explanations behind the findings, then accept, revise, or reject the proposed changes before advising the client.

Watch John explain the workflow, and read the full story: https://openai.com/index/sullivan-cromwell/

result.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
result.description:
Amp is building an AI agent that helps developers turn ideas into working software, from deciding what to build to writing code to onboarding customers.

Sign in with ChatGPT gives Amp users access to more tokens for larger tasks, while Amp's conversational assistant, Puck, uses GPT‑Live‑1 to help users launch and manage agents by voice.

Internally, the company’s 20-person team uses GPT‑6 Astra to write documentation, design pages, and support marketing.

See how Amp is bringing agents into more of the work before and after coding, and exploring faster workflows with Ultrafast. 

Read the full story → https://openai.com/index/amp-beyond-coding/

result.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
result.description:
Stack Overflow is building a knowledge intelligence platform that turns information scattered across workplace tools into verified knowledge for people and AI agents.

The company's latest product, Stack Overflow for Agents, was built from the ground up by two engineers in just a few weeks using Codex. To distribute it, Stack launched a ChatGPT plugin, and signups tripled overnight. Users also created up to 10x more agents.

See how the team is accelerating development and bringing company knowledge into the tools people already use.

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/stack-overflow-chatgpt-plugin/

result.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
result.description:
Higgsfield is building an AI video and image creation platform that helps creators and small teams produce everything from instructional videos to fashion campaigns.

With GPT‑6 Astra, the company has gone from creating videos around one minute long to videos over 10 minutes. GPT‑Image‑2.5 helps businesses create visuals with readable text and precise infographics, while Codex helps Higgsfield’s creative team turn ideas into software prototypes.

See how Higgsfield is helping smaller teams take on more ambitious creative work and exploring voice-driven filmmaking with GPT‑Live‑1.

Read the full story → https://openai.com/index/higgsfield-longer-videos-voice/
